payload.content: St_Marys_Center_Triage status: 8 patients queued for step 0 (1h each), capacity 4. Inventory covers needs (PPE_Sets 21, IV_Kits 20 vs 8 required each). No deficit. Surplus available: ~13 PPE_Sets, ~12 IV_Kits — other hospitals with deficits, please request via the Provisioner.

St_Marys_Center_Radiology status: Job queue EMPTY (no Radiology steps to schedule yet, iter=1). Inventory adequate: Radio_Contrast 9, PPE_Sets 21, IV_Kits 20. If the 8 Triage-queued patients flow through Radiology, expected need ~8 Radio_Contrast (only ~1 excess — NOT surplus), ~13 PPE_Sets excess, ~12 IV_Kits excess (already offered by Triage). No deficit at Radiology. Standing by for queue updates.

General_Hospital_Radiology status: Job queue EMPTY (iter=1, planning). Inventory: Radio_Contrast 9, PPE_Sets 21, IV_Kits 20. Cost per Radiology patient: 1 Radio_Contrast, 1 PPE_Set, 1 IV_Kit. No current deficit. NOTE: Radio_Contrast is the tightest resource — if a large Triage queue flows into Radiology, we could approach zero. General_Hospital_Triage: please share your queue size so Radiology can plan resource needs. No surplus offered at this time (Radio_Contrast excess would be <5 even at full flow; PPE/IV shared with other departments).

General_Hospital_Surgery status: Job queue EMPTY (iter=1, planning). Inventory: Anesthetics 7, Surgical_Packs 7, PPE_Sets 21, IV_Kits 20, Pain_Killers 12. Cost per Surgery patient: 1 Anesthetic, 1 Surgical_Pack, 2 PPE_Sets, 1 IV_Kit, 1 Pain_Killer. No confirmed surplus yet — my excess depends on how many surgical patients arrive from Triage. General_Hospital_Triage: please share how many patients will need Surgery so I can firm up resource needs. No transfer offers at this time (PPE_Sets/IV_Kits are shared with Radiology/Ward at this hospital).

St_Marys_Center_Surgery status: Job queue EMPTY (iter=1, planning). Inventory: Anesthetics 7, Surgical_Packs 7, PPE_Sets 21, IV_Kits 20, Pain_Killers 12. Cost per Surgery patient: 1 Anesthetic, 1 Surgical_Pack, 2 PPE_Sets, 1 IV_Kit, 1 Pain_Killer. CAUTION: If a large share of the 8 Triage-queued patients needs Surgery, I could be SHORT by ~1 Anesthetic and ~1 Surgical_Pack. Therefore I am NOT offering transfers of Anesthetics/Surgical_Packs/Pain_Killers — resource failure risk (-300) outweighs holding cost (-10/unit). St_Marys_Center_Triage: please share how many of your 8 patients will need Surgery so I can firm up my deficit/surplus position. Note: my PPE_Sets/IV_Kits are shared with Radiology/Ward at this hospital, so the ~13 PPE/~12 IV 'surplus' claimed by Triage is likely overstated once Radiology and Ward needs are counted.

St_Marys_Center_Ward status: Job queue EMPTY (iter=1, planning). Cost per Ward patient: 1 Oxygen_Tank, 1 IV_Kit, 1 Pain_Killer, 1 PPE_Set. If all 8 Triage-queued patients flow through Ward, Ward needs ~8 of each — covered (Oxygen_Tanks 10, IV_Kits 20, Pain_Killers 12, PPE_Sets 21). Ward-only excess: Oxygen_Tanks ~2 (below 5 threshold, NOT surplus), Pain_Killers ~4 (NOT surplus). CAUTION to St_Marys_Center_Triage: the ~13 PPE_Sets / ~12 IV_Kits 'surplus' is shared hospital-wide (Triage + Radiology + Surgery + Ward all consume from the same pool). If patients flow through multiple departments, hospital-level PPE/IV needs could exceed 21/20 — please do not transfer shared PPE_Sets/IV_Kits out until all department needs are confirmed. No deficit at Ward; no transfers offered at this time.

General_Hospital_Ward status: Job queue EMPTY (iter=1, planning). Cost per Ward patient: 1 Oxygen_Tank, 1 IV_Kit, 1 Pain_Killer, 1 PPE_Set. If up to 8 patients flow through Ward, needs ~8 of each — covered (Oxygen_Tanks 10, IV_Kits 20, Pain_Killers 12, PPE_Sets 21). Ward-only excess: Oxygen_Tanks ~2, Pain_Killers ~4 (both below 5-unit threshold, NOT surplus). CAUTION to General_Hospital_Triage: the hospital-wide IV_Kits (20) and PPE_Sets (21) pools are shared by Triage + Radiology + Surgery + Ward here. If patients flow through multiple departments, hospital-level PPE/IV needs could exceed 21/20 — please do NOT transfer shared PPE_Sets/IV_Kits out of General_Hospital until all department needs are confirmed. No deficit at Ward; no transfers offered at this time.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Resource_Provisioner, General_Hospital_Triage

payload.content: Ops plan (planning phase 1): Reviewed inventory. GH and StM both already at IV=20, PPE=21 — well above safe buffers, so no top-ups needed this phase (sending more would just incur holding cost). No active failures, no critical shortages, no imbalances between hospitals. Standing by for any URGENT/DEFICIT requests; if GH bottlenecks dip below safe levels (IV<6 or PPE<8), I'll top up immediately in the same phase.

Ops plan (planning phase 1) — GH_Triage: Job queue has 8 triage steps (Patient_0..7, step 0, 1h each). Inventory check: IV=20, PPE=21 at GH — well above what 8 patients need (8 each), so no shortage risk and no public top-up request needed this phase (buffers safe, avoid holding cost). Plan: schedule all 8 triage steps at their earliest feasible start times (P5@0, P4@2, P1@4, P7@7, P6@8, P0@18, P2@19, P3@20), no duplicates. No transfers planned. RP: please stand by in case IV/PPE dip below 6/8 at GH; if so I'll flag it immediately.
